::: {#thm-negate-conditional}
#### Negating a conditional

For propositions $P$ and $Q$, $\neg (P \Rightarrow Q) \equiv P \land \neg Q$.

:::

::: {.content-hidden when-format="revealjs"}

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: proof

By @def-implies, $P \Rightarrow Q$ is false exactly when $P$ is true and $Q$ is false,
so $\neg (P \Rightarrow Q)$ is true exactly in that row.
$P \land \neg Q$ is true exactly when $P$ is true and $\neg Q$ is true,
which is the same row.

:::

:::
